text:
maya: Quick check — APAC rack ETA and quota handoff for the billing demo next Tues. Vendor said rack arrives Mon night but we still need a quota bump on the GCP project redwood-apac-1 (requested +40 A100s). Anyone have final ok or blockers?

sanjay: I pinged vendor earlier, ETA Monday ~22:00 local, but networking team needs rack serials for crossconnect. Have they sent the manifest yet? :eyes:

vendor-ops: Manifest uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-vendor/manifests/318765/manifest.csv. Serial list + initial burn-in report attached. Also opened procurement ticket P-1219.

maya: link? also who owns the quota request? I started a support case with GCP but haven't escalated.

lina: I'll own the quota escalate. Can you add me to the GCP ticket? project: redwood-apac-1, quota type: GPUs, region: asia-southeast1. @vendor-ops can you confirm SKU (A100 80GB or other)?

vendor-ops: Confirmed SKU: a100-80gb (nvidia-a100-80gb). We specified 40 sustained + 8 burst in the manifest. Procurement ticket P-1219 references the same numbers.

tomas: FYI billing needs the PO before we can accept the reserved capacity. PO is in the finance pipeline, cc @maya.

sanjay: For Terraform, PR is tiny — holding until quota approved. Snippet below:
```hcl
resource "google_project_service" "compute" {
  project = "redwood-apac-1"
}
resource "google_project_quota" "gpus" {
  project = "redwood-apac-1"
  region  = "asia-southeast1"
  metrics = [{ metric = "NVIDIA_GPU", limit = 48 }]
}
```
Leaving it as draft until we have confirmation.

maya: Lina can you confirm you got the GCP ticket number? Also what's our fallback if the rack slips 24+ hrs — spot fallback or borrow from EU pool?

lina: GCP case #INC-893211 created and assigned to quota team. I've escalated to an SE. Fallback plan: (1) enable pre-provisioned spot-burst pool in us-west2 (we have capacity reserved there), (2) if we need more deterministic perf, vendor has H100s in EU we can borrow for 24–48h but that requires job routing changes. I'll coordinate the routing change runbook if needed.

oncall-bot: Deploy bot: terraform apply in infra/gcp applied by @sanjay at 2026-03-17T09:45Z :white_check_mark:

maya: Awesome. Sanjay can you rebase the PR, mark it ready, and drop into staging once quota shows green? I'll schedule a quick sync at 14:00 PT to hand off checklist and crossconnect steps.

tomas: Sent PO email to finance, tracking #PO-6782. Finance acknowledged receipt — ETA for PO approval is EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup: 

lina: Added @maya and @sanjay to GCP case INC-893211. Will post updates here as I get them.

maya: Thanks all — please ping in-thread with any blockers. If vendor confirms manifest + PO by EOD we'll proceed with crossconnect scheduling.
